Description: Functional immunofluorescence assay to measure dose dependent changes in antiviral-drug inhibitory efficacy against hCoV-19/USA-WA1/2020 in iPSC-Pneumocyte cells which are seeded prior to treatment, then infected with hCoV-19/USA-WA1/2020. Cells are fixed with 10 % formaldehyde, washed with PBS, permeabilized with permeabilization buffer, then washed with wash buffer. The cells are incubated with nucleoprotein primary antibody IC7C7. Following primary staining, cells are washed with wash buffer and incubated in a solution of with Alexa fluor 488 and DAPI. Infected and uninfected cells are visualized and analyzed by Gen5 software. The assay has been performed by Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai.
Inhibition of SARS-CoV-2-induced cytopathy was measured 4 days after infection of EGFP-labeled Green monkey Vero cells by fluorescence imaging.
